description: Status, progress, and cost of one People Search task, plus a page of the people found so far: name, handle, url, platform, audience, location, fit score, why they matched, contacts, and links. Free. People arrive while the search runs: pass the returned next_cursor as cursor on the next call to get only the people found since then. When done is true and has_more is false you have everyone the search found. An ended task has completion_reason (why it stopped), coverage_limited: true when a budget stopped it before count (more people may match), and warnings such as partial_enrichment (some profiles could not be read, so those people were scored on the search hit; they show enrichment: failed). Each person has fully_verified (every criterion confirmed by their own profile or posts) and unverified_criteria (criteria that are unknown or not met, or a disqualifier that applies). These are information only: the person still qualified.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous people-search-status call. Omit to start from the first person.

include_people.description: Set false to read only the status, progress, and cost.

name: people-search-status
title: Get People Search Status
